name: mostro-tshirts
description: The Mostro t-shirt store (store.mostro.network) and its viewer, which previews designs on every shirt colour.

scripts.test:e2e: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('coverage/e2e', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node --test --test-concurrency=1 'tests/e2e/*.e2e.js'
scripts.coverage:all: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && npm run coverage -- --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/unit.lcov && npm run test:e2e && node tests/e2e/report.js
